correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts residue types modulo p. Type A is full spark by the inspected prime-power theorem; B-by-B has determinant equal up to sign to a product of two nonzero root-of-unity differences after row subtraction; C-by-B and B-by-C have rank exactly two; C-by-C factors as an outer product and has rank one. Counting is direct. Exact cyclotomic replay at p=3 and p=5 corroborates all ranks.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The prime-power full-spark result is broader over row-set sizes but weaker for the present local question: it certifies all minors at once or not, without classifying the failing minors. General uncertainty inequalities give support bounds rather than this rank census.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: For three rows at p^2, Theorem 9 proves the type-A rows have no singular 3x3 minor. It does not imply that B-by-B is always nonsingular, that C-by-B has rank two, that C-by-C has rank one, or the exact counts.
